issues.description: SQL Injection vulnerability in searchTodos function - user input is directly interpolated into SQL query using template literals
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized queries: `const query = 'SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE $1 OR description LIKE $2'; const rows = await db.query(query, [`%${keyword}%`, `%${keyword}%`]);`

issues.description: SQL Injection vulnerability in searchTodosByStatus function - user input is concatenated directly into SQL query without validation or parameterization
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized queries with proper type validation: `const query = 'SELECT * FROM todos WHERE completed = $1'; const isCompleted = completed === 'true'; await db.query(query, [isCompleted]);`

issues.description: SQL Injection vulnerability in getTodosByUser function - userId is interpolated directly into SQL query without sanitization
issues.suggestion: Use parameterized queries: `const query = 'SELECT t.* FROM todos t JOIN user_todos ut ON t.id = ut.todo_id WHERE ut.user_id = $1'; const rows = await db.query(query, [userId]);`

issues.description: XSS sanitization is incomplete and insufficient - only handles HTML entities but misses other attack vectors like JavaScript events, CSS injection, and Unicode encoding attacks
issues.suggestion: Use a well-tested sanitization library like DOMPurify or validator.js instead of manual regex replacement. If storing in database, consider storing raw data and sanitizing only on output based on context (HTML, JSON, etc.)

issues.description: Database query result type is unsafely cast to Todo[] without validation - could cause runtime errors if database schema differs from expected structure
issues.suggestion: Implement runtime validation: `const todos = rows.map(row => ({ id: String(row.id), title: String(row.title), description: String(row.description), completed: Boolean(row.completed), createdAt: new Date(row.created_at) }));` or use a validation library like zod or io-ts

issues.description: Database result unsafely cast to Todo without runtime validation - no guarantee the row matches the Todo interface structure
issues.suggestion: Add runtime validation before casting: validate that all required fields exist and have correct types before returning as Todo

issues.description: searchTodosByStatus accepts string parameter but SQL expects boolean - type mismatch will cause incorrect queries or errors
issues.suggestion: Change parameter type to boolean: `export async function searchTodosByStatus(completed: boolean): Promise<Todo[]>` and use parameterized query with the boolean value

issues.description: updateTodoStatus does not verify if the todo exists before updating - silent failure if ID doesn't exist
issues.suggestion: Check affected rows or query for the todo first: `const result = await db.query(query, [completed, id]); if (result.rowCount === 0) { throw new Error('Todo not found'); }`

issues.description: deleteTodo does not verify if the todo exists before deleting - silent failure if ID doesn't exist
issues.suggestion: Check affected rows: `const result = await db.query(query, [id]); if (result.rowCount === 0) { throw new Error('Todo not found'); }`

issues.description: generateId uses Math.random() which is cryptographically insecure - predictable IDs could enable enumeration attacks or ID guessing
issues.suggestion: Use crypto.randomUUID() for secure random IDs: `import { randomUUID } from 'crypto'; function generateId(): string { return randomUUID(); }`

issues.description: generateId using Date.now() combined with Math.random() could produce duplicate IDs if called multiple times in the same millisecond with unlucky random values
issues.suggestion: Use crypto.randomUUID() which guarantees uniqueness: `import { randomUUID } from 'crypto'; function generateId(): string { return randomUUID(); }`

issues.description: Database module import './database' is not validated - no type information about db.query signature
issues.suggestion: Create a proper database interface: `interface Database { query<T = any>(sql: string, params?: any[]): Promise<T[]>; }` and type the import or create a typed database client

issues.description: Error thrown with generic message doesn't provide enough context for debugging or user feedback
issues.suggestion: Throw more specific errors with validation details: `throw new Error('Invalid todo input: title is required and must be 1-200 characters, description must be under 1000 characters');`

issues.description: Sanitizing data before storing in database - this is context-inappropriate as SQL injection should be prevented via parameterized queries, not sanitization
issues.suggestion: Remove HTML sanitization from database storage (lines 59-60). Store raw user input and apply context-appropriate escaping only when rendering (e.g., HTML escape for web display). The parameterized queries already prevent SQL injection.

issues.description: Validation allows empty description but doesn't explicitly handle null vs empty string - inconsistent optional handling
issues.suggestion: Be explicit about optional values: `if (input.description !== undefined && input.description !== null && input.description.length > 1000) { return false; }`

issues.description: Todo interface uses string for id - consider using a branded type to prevent mixing regular strings with IDs
issues.suggestion: Use a branded type for type safety: `export type TodoId = string & { readonly __brand: 'TodoId' }; export interface Todo { id: TodoId; ... }`

issues.description: Todo interface fields are all mutable - consider using readonly for immutability
issues.suggestion: Make interface readonly: `export interface Todo { readonly id: string; readonly title: string; readonly description: string; readonly completed: boolean; readonly createdAt: Date; }`

issues.description: getAllTodos retrieves all todos without pagination - could cause performance issues with large datasets
issues.suggestion: Add pagination parameters: `export async function getAllTodos(limit: number = 50, offset: number = 0): Promise<Todo[]> { const query = 'SELECT * FROM todos ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2'; ... }`

codeQuality.summary: The code contains 3 CRITICAL SQL injection vulnerabilities (searchTodos, searchTodosByStatus, getTodosByUser) that allow arbitrary SQL execution. Multiple HIGH severity issues include unsafe database result casting without validation and type mismatches. The code correctly uses parameterized queries in some functions but inconsistently applies this security practice. Additional concerns include insecure ID generation using Math.random(), incomplete XSS sanitization, missing error handling for non-existent records, and lack of pagination. Immediate remediation of SQL injection vulnerabilities is required before production use.

testCoverage.summary: ZERO test coverage detected. No test files exist for src/todo.ts. The file contains 9 exported functions with 3 CRITICAL SQL injection vulnerabilities (searchTodos, searchTodosByStatus, getTodosByUser) that are completely untested. Critical security functions (sanitizeInput, validateTodoInput) have no test coverage. Edge cases around input validation, error handling, boundary conditions, and database failures are all untested. Recommended immediate action: Create comprehensive test suite starting with security vulnerability tests, then input validation, then happy paths for all CRUD operations.

suggestions.description: Introduce Repository pattern to encapsulate all database operations. This improves separation of concerns, testability, and makes it easier to swap database implementations.
suggestions.benefits: Separates data access from business logic, improves testability by allowing repository mocking, centralizes SQL queries, makes it easier to add caching or switch databases, and follows SOLID principles (Single Responsibility).

suggestions.description: Replace boolean validation return with Result/Either pattern or throw descriptive errors. The current approach loses information about what validation failed.
suggestions.benefits: Provides clear error messages to users about what failed validation, improves debugging, enables better error handling in API responses, and follows the fail-fast principle with actionable feedback.

suggestions.description: Replace manual XSS sanitization with a well-tested library like DOMPurify or validator.js. Manual sanitization is error-prone and incomplete.
suggestions.benefits: Uses battle-tested security libraries that handle edge cases, provides more comprehensive XSS protection, reduces maintenance burden, and follows security best practice of not rolling your own security functions.

suggestions.description: Fix SQL injection vulnerability by using parameterized queries. This is a critical security issue that allows arbitrary SQL execution.
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates SQL injection vulnerability (OWASP A03:2021), prevents attackers from executing arbitrary SQL commands, protects data integrity and confidentiality, and follows secure coding best practices for database queries.

suggestions.description: Fix SQL injection vulnerability and add type safety by accepting boolean parameter instead of string, then use parameterized query.
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates SQL injection vulnerability (OWASP A03:2021), adds type safety by using boolean instead of string, prevents malicious SQL injection attacks, and ensures the function accepts only valid boolean values.

suggestions.description: Fix SQL injection vulnerability by using parameterized queries for the userId parameter.
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates SQL injection vulnerability (OWASP A03:2021), protects against unauthorized data access, prevents attackers from manipulating query logic, and maintains consistency with other secure functions in the file.

suggestions.description: Extract todo object construction logic into a separate factory function to improve testability and reusability.
suggestions.benefits: Separates object construction from database operations, makes todo creation logic testable without database, enables reuse of construction logic, and improves readability by reducing function complexity.

suggestions.description: Replace custom ID generation with UUID library for better uniqueness guarantees and collision resistance.

refactorings.summary: The file has 12 significant refactoring opportunities: 3 critical SQL injection vulnerabilities that must be fixed immediately using parameterized queries (searchTodos, searchTodosByStatus, getTodosByUser); introduction of Repository pattern to improve architecture and separation of concerns; replacement of manual XSS sanitization with established libraries; improved error handling with custom error classes; extraction of todo construction logic; better validation with descriptive errors; replacement of custom ID generation with UUID; type safety improvements with readonly modifiers and runtime validation; and extraction of magic numbers into constants. The security fixes are highest priority, followed by architectural improvements for long-term maintainability.

recommendations.description: Fix SQL injection vulnerabilities in searchTodos, searchTodosByStatus, and getTodosByUser functions by replacing string concatenation and template literals with parameterized queries. These vulnerabilities allow arbitrary SQL execution and represent OWASP A03:2021 Injection risks.

Create comprehensive test suite with 0% coverage currently. Prioritize security tests for SQL injection vulnerabilities, XSS prevention, input validation boundary conditions, and error handling scenarios. All 9 exported functions are completely untested.

Add runtime validation for database query results before casting to TypeScript types. Current unsafe type assertions could hide schema mismatches and cause runtime errors. Implement a mapRowToTodo function with proper validation.

Introduce Repository pattern to separate data access logic from business logic. This improves testability, enables easier database mocking in tests, centralizes SQL queries, and follows SOLID principles.

Replace manual XSS sanitization with well-tested libraries like validator.js or DOMPurify. The current implementation is incomplete and misses attack vectors like JavaScript events, CSS injection, and Unicode encoding attacks.

Fix type mismatch in searchTodosByStatus function which accepts string parameter but should accept boolean. Change parameter type and use parameterized query to prevent type confusion and SQL injection.

Add verification that records exist before updating or deleting in updateTodoStatus and deleteTodo functions. Currently these functions silently succeed even when the ID doesn't exist, which can mask bugs.

Replace Math.random() based ID generation with crypto.randomUUID() for cryptographically secure, collision-resistant unique IDs. Current implementation is predictable and could enable enumeration attacks.
Implement custom error classes (TodoValidationError, TodoNotFoundError, TodoDatabaseError) to provide better error context and enable specific error handling in API layers.
Add pagination to getAllTodos function to prevent performance issues with large datasets. Implement limit and offset parameters with sensible defaults (e.g., 50 items per page).
